invariants.rationale: The method always returns a new int[] of length 2, so result should never be null.
The returned array always has exactly two elements: left and right.
By construction, left (result[0]) is less than or equal to right (result[1]).
left is initialized to 0 and only increased, so result[0] is always >= 0.
right is never set to a value larger than this.text.length().
